# Mike Vasquez
## Mike Vasquez
### Title
**Michael Vasquez** is a Hot Wheels designer working at Mattel since 2022. He specializes in graphic design, with his current role being a product and package designer for Mattel; he is known to work on graphics for the Hot Wheels Skate and Hot Wheels RacerVerse series. He is known for his comic book illustrations, particularly of _Rick & Morty_ , having worked as a graphic designer for numerous companies in the past.
